answer: bridge ties all keys with one operator credential to a single history. falcon signs that history at most once per epoch for judged work, however many keys work concurrently; each signature adds one nontransferable plume. Admitting key k requires 2^k − 1 plume, so key k costs 2^(k−1) further attested epochs: key ten costs 512, ten cost 1,023 sequential epochs, and an honest first key costs one. Fresh wallets cannot split the history.
